Do you remain fully conscious and aware while they occur?
Are the movements confined mainly to your right arm?

results: 1. tremor frequency estimate: slow, under about 4.5 Hz, with a wing-beating quality
2. brain MRI: thalamic lesion (tuberculoma) that DECREASED in size after anti-tuberculous treatment, with no gliosis
3. tuberculosis treatment history: CNS tuberculoma treated with anti-tuberculous therapy; the tremor began after treatment was completed
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Holmes (rubral) tremor caused by a post-treatment thalamic tuberculoma lesion

Alternative 1: Cerebellar outflow tremor secondary to thalamic involvement

Alternative 2: Dystonic tremor

Alternative 3: Functional neurological tremor
dx: Holmes (rubral) tremor caused by a post-treatment thalamic tuberculoma lesion
